title: Latent Imagination for Parameterized Action Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.15744v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parameterized-action MDPs (PAMDPs) ask an agent to choose a discrete action together with continuous parameters whose meaning depends on that choice. Model-free PAMDP methods act fast but need many interactions; model-based methods are sample-efficient but plan at every decision, which makes them slow to act. We introduce HyLI (Hybrid Latent Imagination), a model-based agent that learns a hybrid policy entirely in the latent imagination of a world model and acts with a single forward pass. To address learning problems that the PAMDP structure creates, HyLI adds counterfactual mode evaluation, which gives every discrete action a learning signal at every imagined state, and success-window replay, which keeps rare successes in training. translated_title: 参数化动作空间的潜在想象
translated_abstract: 参数化动作马尔可夫决策过程（PAMDP）要求智能体选择一个离散动作，同时选择一组连续参数，而这些参数的含义依赖于所选的离散动作。无模型的PAMDP方法行动快速但需要大量的环境交互；基于模型的方法样本效率高，但需要在每次决策时进行规划，导致其行动迟缓。我们提出了HyLI（混合潜在想象，Hybrid Latent Imagination），这是一个基于模型的智能体，它完全在世界模型的潜在想象中学习混合策略，并仅需单次前向传播即可执行动作。为解决PAMDP结构所带来的学习问题，HyLI引入了反事实模式评估（在每个想象状态下为每个离散动作提供学习信号）以及成功窗口回放（在训练中保留罕见的成功经验）。在七个标准PAMDP基准测试中，HyLI在我们比较中的最强无模型基线的已发表分数的一个标准差范围内，或在全部7个任务上均达到或超过该分数，达到了90%的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HyLI是一种完全在世界模型的潜在想象中学习混合策略、并通过单次前向传播执行动作的基于模型的智能体，借助反事实模式评估和成功窗口回放解决了参数化动作MDP的学习难题，在七个标准基准上达到与最强无模型基线相当的性能。
en_tdlr: HyLI is a model-based agent that learns a hybrid policy entirely within a world model's latent imagination and acts with a single forward pass, using counterfactual mode evaluation and success-window replay to overcome PAMDP learning challenges and match the strongest model-free baselines across seven benchmarks.
